verdict.rationale: Loops is an email platform, not an agent or AI assistant that hosts tools. Plugging external MCP servers into it as a client is outside its product role. The evidence shows Loops acting only as an MCP server (a hosted endpoint at mcp.loops.so for external agents), which is the opposite role and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing shows an in-product agent that consumes other MCP servers.
